answer.generated: A deadlock occurs when two or more transactions wait indefinitely for each other to release a lock, creating a cyclic dependency that prevents any of them from completing. This situation, often referred to as a "deadly embrace," arises when transactions hold locks on certain data and simultaneously request additional locks held by other transactions, leading to mutual blocking.
